misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast record linked to its issuance time, evidence cutoff, specification, and matured outcome could make it possible to assess forecast performance without hindsight. The supplied evidence does not show that this would have changed a decision or prevented a loss.
misses.decision_relevance: The registry identifies missing forecast-to-outcome lineage as an auditability gap. Settlement records provide target-time prices, but explicitly do not supply linked prior forecast specifications or decision-time evidence cutoffs.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices are supplied, but no corresponding prior forecast specification, issuance timestamp, or eligible evidence cutoff is linked. Therefore these records do not demonstrate a forecast failure or other decision miss.
misses.missing_history_problem: Frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps.
misses.outcome_reference: The supplied FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 and EXP-FC-ff8bbf351d863d4efd90; registry validation states no eligible forecast lineage or decision value is established.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
